name: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith

passives: Ma’at Source Law: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith gains Solar Charge when its defender choices express Solar Dominion of Khepra source-culture law through Aten-lit judgment ground; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Aten-Ra is the living office humans later remembered as Ra, Aten, and divine kingship fused together. He does not wear pharaoh imagery — pharaohs copied his Gate-born crown, collar, and solar hand-rays after dreaming of the Sun-Scale Gate. On the battlefield he anchors Ma’at itself, forcing chaos to declare its weight before it can pass.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Colossal living solar judge with readable divine anatomy, an Aten sun-disc crown radiating subtle hand-like rays, electrum wesekh collar fused into chest armor, Ma’at feather balance seams, white-gold noon aura, black-lapis shadow insets, and pylon-shaped shield forearms. Must feel older than Egyptian royalty, not a statue, robot, sarcophagus, or pyramid body.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

passives: Debt With Teeth: Zerath Wound Gate gains Contract Debt when its assassin choices express Infernal Dominion source-culture law through black-iron contract ground; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Zerath Wound Gate is a colossal Infernal Dominion assassin from The Infernal Dominion. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Infernal Dominion assassin office: hidden name, silent verdict, secret execution; Horns/wings/claws: rank, predation, nobility, monstrous majesty.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Zerath Wound Gate shows black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.. Role silhouette must read as Assassin. Materials include black iron, volcanic glass, obsidian, blood wax, ash velvet, molten gold, charred parchment. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid red robot demon, generic Halloween devil, sci-fi cables, literal castle armor, block fortress body, cartoon pitchfork.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate — Black-Iron Clause Cut Execution
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal Dominion source-culture damage at range 1; generate Momentum and a small Contract Debt gain when used from black-iron contract ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Titan into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Blood-Wax Contract Technique — Shadow Pursuit
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to hunts marked targets, erases escape routes, and creates a precise execution window with recovery risk. Builds Contract Debt only when the player uses black-iron contract ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate: Abyssal Debt Verdict Final Name Cut
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Contract Debt to impose a two-round rule from Infernal Dominion: hunts marked targets, erases escape routes, and creates a precise execution window with recovery risk. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Titan, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Hell-Crown Dominion Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Contract Debt, transform nearby terrain into black-iron contract ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate Name-Knife Goetic Chain-Crown Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through black-iron contract ground. Visual: black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate Volcanic Glass Debtor Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Titan read as Infernal Dominion source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate Blood-Wax Infernal Ledger Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Contract Debt and unlocks a mastery branch for Abyssal Clause Step, Chain-Lien Reversal, and Collect the Soul Clause. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.
